groups.name: Elective(s) - Social Science Electives
groups.note: SOSC Social Science Electives: 8 courses (24 credits) from the specified elective list; students should take at least 2 Foundation courses each from a different discipline (Foundation 1 Geography/Demography: SOSC 1780, SOSC 1860; Foundation 2 Economics: SOSC 1440; Foundation 3 Political Science: SOSC 1300; Foundation 4 Psychology: SOSC 1960, SOSC 1980; Foundation 5 Sociology: SOSC 1850), and out of the 24 credits, at least 6 credits must be at 3000-/4000-level. Other SOSC courses (any except Foundation and Methodological Electives) also qualify. The PDF provides a Foundation list but the remainder is open-ended; only the Foundation courses are enumerated.

groups.name: Elective(s) - QSA Methodological Electives
groups.note: QSA Methodological Electives: 4 courses (12 credits) from the specified elective list, of which 6 credits must be taken in SOSC. The listed SOSC courses and the MATH/COMP courses are enumerated; 'SOSC Any SOSC courses ...' portion is open-ended.
